title: A loan calculator
description:
Write `final class Loan` with:

- `static BigDecimal monthlyPayment(String principal, String annualRatePercent, int months)`: the fixed monthly payment of a loan, `P × r / (1 − (1 + r)^−n)` where `r` is the monthly rate (the annual percentage / 100 / 12) and `n` the number of months. A rate of 0 gives `P / n`. Compute with `MathContext.DECIMAL64` and round the result to 2 places with `HALF_UP`. `months` below 1 throws `IllegalArgumentException`.
- `static BigDecimal totalInterest(String principal, String annualRatePercent, int months)`: payment × months − principal, with 2 decimals.
- `static long checkedTotalCents(long[] amounts)`: the sum of amounts in cents using `Math.addExact`, so an overflow throws `ArithmeticException` instead of wrapping.
hints: `BigDecimal.ONE.add(r, mc).pow(months, mc)` is `(1 + r)^n`; dividing one by it gives `(1 + r)^−n` (lesson 8.04).
Every division of `BigDecimal` needs a `MathContext` or a scale and rounding mode, or it throws when the result has endless digits.
